cmdString:
id
cat /etc/os-release
uname -m
command -v node || true
node --version 2>/dev/null || true
command -v nginx || true
sudo -n true && printf 'SUDO_READY\n'
sudo -n ss -ltnp
df -h /
free -m
systemctl is-active nginx 2>/dev/null || true
ls -ld /opt/artifact-threefold /var/lib/artifact-threefold /etc/nginx/sites-enabled 2>/dev/null || true
